organization.name: Tableau (Salesforce)
organization.notes: Tableau company founded 2003; acquired by Salesforce in 2019. Funding status reflects public-parent ownership; historical Tableau equity investors not resolved from the official history and acquisition sources inspected. Salesforce is acquirer, not labelled venture investor.

pricingTiers.name: Tableau Standard
pricingTiers.notes: Starting at $15/user/month billed annually ×12 = $180. Entry role is not complete deployment cost: at least one Creator required.
No public Most popular or Recommended plan designation found in the source inspected; no popularity inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Tableau Standard
pricingTiers.notes: Closest organizational edition; starting Viewer-level amount $15/user/month yearly ×12. Creator/Explorer/Viewer mix determines total; at least one Creator required.

pricingTiers.name: Tableau Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Starting $35/user/month billed annually ×12 = $420; at least one Creator required. Cloud+ and capacity pricing require sales quote.

moats.claim: Established visualization workbooks, analytical skills and reusable data preparation flows make migration costly for existing analytics teams.

productReasons.claim: Visual exploration lets analysts discover relationships while building interactive analytical views.
Prep Builder and Desktop connect data preparation with analysis in the same product family.
Pulse metrics help business users follow important measures without manually opening every dashboard.
